credits.title: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
credits.overview: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

credits.title: A Dog's Journey
credits.overview: A dog finds the meaning of his own existence through the lives of the humans he meets.

credits.title: A Dog's Way Home
credits.overview: The adventure of Bella, a dog who embarks on an epic 400-mile journey home after she is separated from her beloved human.

credits.title: Cook-Off!
credits.overview: Amateur 'chefs' from around the country compete for a million dollar prize in the ultimate food fight.

credits.title: A Dog's Purpose
credits.overview: A dog goes on quest to discover his purpose in life over the course of several lifetimes with multiple owners.

credits.title: Muffin Top: A Love Story
credits.overview: Suzanne’s body is changing faster than her moods after IVF shots to get pregnant. When she finds out, on her birthday, that her husband has knocked up his younger, thinner co-worker and wants a divorce, she turns to desperate and hilarious measures to lose weight and get a life.

credits.title: Fired!
